rawFindings.title: Original schema argument object is altered
rawFindings.explanation: Line 40 was changed from directly assigning castOptions = cast to cloning the cast object before modifying it. Without cloning, the original user argument object passed to the Schema constructor would be mutated when castOptions is modified, which breaks the expectation that input schema definitions are not changed by Mongoose.
rawFindings.suggestion: Clone the cast object before using or modifying it to avoid mutating the original argument object, as done by adding 'castOptions = utils.clone(cast);' before assigning 'cast = cast.type'. This is the proper fix to prevent user input alteration.
